steps.title: Initialize Android Project Structure
steps.description: Create basic folder hierarchy and set up initial configuration files for 'Quiz Card Creator'.

steps.title: Configure Gradle Build Environment
steps.description: Configure 'app/build.gradle' targeting compile SDK 34, AGP 8.3.2, and Gradle 8.5 with strict Java 8 compatibility settings.

steps.title: Establish Android Manifest & Permissions
steps.description: Configure 'AndroidManifest.xml' with necessary storage permissions and register 'MainActivity' with appropriate launch intent-filters.

steps.title: Design Application Layout
steps.description: Create 'activity_main.xml' featuring a live 16:9 interactive preview container, customizable controller widgets, text edit fields, and action buttons.

steps.title: Construct Question Data Structure
steps.description: Define internal 'Question' model class with fields for text content, custom themes, options, and text sizing styling.

steps.title: Implement SharedPreferences Persistent Storage
steps.description: Write custom serialization logic utilizing Android standard JSONObject/JSONArray to persist current quiz cards into local storage.

steps.title: Design 16:9 Canvas Graphics Renderer
steps.description: Develop dynamic Canvas painting logic that handles complex linear gradients, overlay shapes, custom margins, and styled dynamic rounded pill backgrounds.

steps.title: Implement Text Wrapping Engine
steps.description: Utilize built-in Android 'StaticLayout' to reliably auto-wrap long quiz questions on the high-definition 1280x720 graphic canvas.

steps.title: Integrate Real-time WYSIWYG Editor Preview
steps.description: Connect TextWatchers and styling selectors to instantly paint and display the generated 16:9 bitmap live on the screen.

steps.title: Build Image Gallery Exporter
steps.description: Write MediaStore insertion routine allowing seamless direct writing of the 16:9 PNG graphic files directly to Pictures/QuizCardPro on Android 5.0 to 14.

steps.title: Develop PDF Merge Compiler
steps.description: Leverage native 'android.graphics.pdf.PdfDocument' framework to dynamically bundle all created 16:9 cards as individual high-quality pages in a single output PDF document.

steps.title: Building Quiz Card Creator
steps.description: Verify namespace parameters, execute compile sequence, pack assets, and construct the final debug APK package.
